table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	invgstperc1 = srbufferledger.invgstperc1,
	discperc = srbufferledger.discperc,   
	discvalue = 0.00,
	flatdisc = srbufferledger.flatdisc,   
	misccharges = srbufferledger.misccharges,
	FBRPosFee = srbufferledger.fbrposfee,
	AdvanceTaxAmt = srbufferledger.AdvanceTaxAmt,
	icode = 0, 
	stock = 0.0000, 
	retableqty = 0.0000,
	saleqty = 0.0000 ,
	retablebonusqty = 0.0000,
	salebonusqty = 0.0000 ,
	piecesinhand=0,
	total = 0.0
FROM 
	srbufferledger  
WHERE 
	srbufferledger.srbufferinvcode = :ra_saleretinvcode
